title: Models and effort
summary: Opus as main model, Sonnet for workers, effort set per model. Check first that your plan includes Fable 5.2.
benefit: Each kind of work runs on a fitting model and effort, so tokens go where they matter.
solves: Switching models and effort by hand, and sub-agents running on a more expensive model than needed.
use_cases: Every session starts on Opus with effort xhigh.
Sub-agents run on Sonnet 5.5 unless a call names another model.
Fable 5.2 and Sonnet 5.5 run at effort high when you switch to them.
You already picked a main model: sync shows the difference and asks which one to keep.
details: Claude runs on Opus with effort xhigh, Fable and Sonnet at high, and sends its sub-agents to Sonnet through CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL; check first that your plan includes Fable 5.2, which the helper agents name. It is for anyone who wants a fixed model setup instead of switching by hand. It changes only settings.json values (the main model, three effort levels and one env value); no code runs and no network is used.
risk: Settings only; changes which models and effort levels Claude uses. No code runs.
